recipe.visualDefinition: A close-up, soft-focus portrait of a woman with long hair and bangs, rendered in a monochromatic cyan and teal palette, featuring a large, elegant script text running vertically along the right edge.
coreVisualRelationships: Monochromatic color harmony between subject and background
Contrast between the soft, diffused photographic texture and sharp, thin-line lettering
Vertical text alignment echoing the flow of the subject's hair

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The subject is positioned slightly off-center to the left, occupying approximately 70% of the frame in a tight headshot.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's eyes, specifically the one not obscured by hair, serve as the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the face, moves downward following the hair, and then travels upward along the vertical script on the right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal negative space, primarily located in the upper right corner where the text begins.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Deep Navy (Deepest shadows in hair and eyes)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation with a compressed value range, leaning towards the highlights to create a 'dreamy' effect.

letterConstructionRules: High-angle slant (approx 45 degrees relative to the vertical baseline)
characterSpecificRedesigns: Ascenders and descenders are exaggerated to fill the vertical space
Capital letters are integrated into the flow without significant size jumps
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single-typeface dominance to maintain the minimalist, monochromatic mood.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the personal, hand-written feel of the original.
Maintains the delicate balance against the soft-focus image.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a soft-focus, grainy portrait of a woman with long hair and bangs, styled in an 80s fashion. Apply a heavy cyan/teal duotone filter so the entire image is monochromatic blue-green.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add custom hand-drawn script lettering vertically along the right side. The text should be white, very thin, and slanted, flowing from top to bottom.

verificationChecks: Is the color palette strictly cyan/teal?
Is the text oriented vertically on the right?
Is the photographic style soft-focus and grainy?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features to avoid likeness issues
Unique handwriting style for the script
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the text is legible despite the vertical orientation.
Check that the cyan tint doesn't blow out facial details.
Verify the script feels integrated into the composition rather than just slapped on.
Confirm the grain texture is consistent across the entire frame.
recipe.reuseFormula: Portrait + Cyan Duotone + Soft Focus + Vertical Monolinear Script Overlay
